ValidationRule.description: These Edits & Updates section fields are mandatory i.e. Date Requested, Requestor Name, Requesting Bottler, Reason, Production Validation and Product Distribution.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR($Profile.Name = 'CCNA Bottler External Team', $Profile.Name = 'CCNA QSE Partner', $Profile.Name = 'CCNA Bottler'), NOT(INCLUDES(Reason__c,'No Edits Requested')), NOT(ISBLANK(Reason__c)), OR( Requestor_Name__c='', Producing_Bottler_Folder__c='', ISPICKVAL(Production_Validation__c,''), ISPICKVAL(Product_Distribution__c,''), ISBLANK(Date_Requested__c) ), CreatedDate > DATETIMEVALUE("2024-12-16 00:00:00") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: All these fields are mandatory i.e. Requestor Name, Requesting Bottler, Reason, Production Validation, Product Distribution and Date Requested.
